purpose: Axon Enjin logo and wordmark rework

prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design a premium NEW LOGO AND WORDMARK EXPLORATION for the exact company name "AXON ENJIN". This is a serious software studio connecting people through technology. "Axon" means a nerve carrying a signal; "Enjin" means the place of connection. Audience: business operators and teams, not gamers. User rejects the current cartoonish condensed logo, its very tall Anton lettering, wide tracking and glowing cyan dot.
Create ONE beautiful horizontal 16:10 compact brand identity concept sheet, very high resolution with substantial readable lettering. Sparse editorial 2x2 composition with generous gutters, NOT nine tiny boxes. Pure near-black #04060d background, flat white/ice lettering, a single Axon cobalt #2e6fff accent. Absolutely no glow, bevel, chrome, gradient, mascot, bubbly rounded letters, sci-fi font, stencil, exaggerated stretched typography, fake metrics or decorative grid. No fibre sculptures inside the logo. Large negative space. Thin gray-blue dividing rules only.
CORE NEW SYMBOL: an original compact flat geometric signal junction, a single route joining into two routes, fused subtly with the negative-space idea of an A. Design it with TWO OR THREE bold continuous shapes maximum, crisp 45-degree junctions and carefully cut internal negative space; simple, balanced, slightly horizontally directed. No enclosing circle/hexagon, no little dots on ends, no circuit-board clipart, no trident, no lightning bolt. It must read as a distinct intentional mark at 20px, and still work fully monochrome. Don't copy any famous logo. The symbol's meaning should be reduced connection geometry, not a literal drawn neuron.
WORDMARK: exact uppercase "AXON ENJIN", in a custom refined neo-grotesk, roughly Neue Montreal/Suisse style medium weight, broad natural proportions, calm straight terminals, mature enterprise feel. Normal optical width, not extra-expanded. Cap height same across all letters. Moderate-to-tight tracking, precise kerning around AX, ON, EN, NJ and JI; clear gap between AXON and ENJIN, no enormous spaced-out letters, no condensed Anton. All one weight, one baseline; ENJIN not a tiny subtitle. Minimal one small precision cut can echo the mark, but letters must remain immediately readable.
TOP LEFT covers 60% of upper half: dominant master lockup, cobalt symbol to the left and white wordmark "AXON ENJIN". Very large, clean. Small understated caption BELOW lockup only 'Signal. Connection. Technology.' in subdued gray, no top eyebrow label.
TOP RIGHT: isolated large white symbol and a small monochrome version of same symbol, exactly same geometry. Tiny text below 'One mark. One colour.'
BOTTOM LEFT: large type specimen "AXON ENJIN" on one line in white, below it short alphabet specimen "Aa Bb Cc 012345" and small caption 'Wordmark study · medium grotesk'. Do not falsely label an exact font file: custom drawn direction only.
BOTTOM RIGHT: the SAME master lockup reversed dark-on-white in one plain generous white rectangle with simple square edges, plus below two tiny but crisp favicon examples in cobalt-on-black and white-on-cobalt. This demonstrates scalability, not app mockups.
Repeat the identical symbol consistently across every use. This is an agency-level identity concept, not a website, not a stationery collage. Let the typography and precise mark do all the work.

Use case: logo-brand. Create a remarkably restrained, grown-up typographic logo presentation for "AXON ENJIN", a software company that connects people through technology. USER REJECTS CARTOONISH LOGOS. This must feel like a precise Swiss identity studio designed it, not a sports brand, gaming logo, crypto startup or heavy tech badge.
ONE horizontal 16:10 identity sheet, TWO clean horizontal zones only. Upper 65% near-black #04060d, lower 35% split into two simple application strips. Huge negative space. No fake texture, gradient, glow, shadows, 3D, slogan, particles, grid, construction decorations or board labels. Primary visual is TYPOGRAPHY.
Upper zone center: a single refined white uppercase wordmark, EXACT 'AXON ENJIN'. Natural-width neo-grotesk custom lettering inspired by a restrained Swiss foundry sans, MEDIUM-LIGHT weight around 450, absolutely NOT bold or extrabold. The letter stems must look elegantly thin, roughly 1/12 of cap height. Cap height around 85px on a 1600px-wide canvas. Tight precise optical kerning, slight positive tracking of only .02em, mature geometry, flat clear terminals, round but not bubbly O, straight N, graceful simple J. Preserve a visible word space. Both words same size, same weight, same baseline. No stretched wide characters, condensed letters, stencil cuts, italic, serif, double strokes or cartoon curves. Make the X beautifully balanced; use only subtle kerning customizations, not angular cuts into letters.
OPTIONAL SYMBOL MUST BE VERY SMALL AND QUIET: immediately left of name, no taller than the wordmark capital height, a flat cobalt minimalist connection glyph made of three fine uniform straight segments forming a horizontal path that branches gently into two paths. Thin-but-solid stroke around 1/10 of cap height, short crisp square terminals, no circles or dots, no triangular A/mountain/arrow/bolt, no thick polygon, no enclosure, no trident. Connection looks like a restrained engineering notation, not a circuit-board clipart. Wordmark should dominate; symbol is supporting. Use one exact glyph consistently.
Lower-left application strip: plain white background with dark wordmark and same flat cobalt small glyph, scaled to a realistic website navigation logo size around 180px wide; to its right in restrained dark-gray sans tiny nav 'Product   Modules   Company', ending with an understated cobalt 'Talk to us' button. This is a simple 64px-tall header application sitting in generous white space, not a full website.
Lower-right application strip: near-black background with white wordmark and cobalt small glyph at the SAME realistic header size, small white nav 'Product   Modules   Company', small cobalt 'Talk to us' button. Again header only, with generous black space.
At bottom under everything, just tiny gray text 'Wordmark direction · optical spacing · monochrome ready'. No font brand name: this is a custom typographic visual study, not an exact installed font specimen.
The result must be quiet and confident, almost obvious but carefully crafted. I should see beautifully spaced medium-light letters, not a heavy icon. If in doubt reduce weight, simplify the symbol, increase breathing room. Render crisp typography and a beautiful modest real-world application.

Edit the attached Axon Enjin identity sheet. Preserve the refined lightweight uppercase "AXON ENJIN" wordmark, its kerning, size, position, white-on-black main lockup, black/cobalt/white palette and the two small light/dark navigation applications below. Change the SYMBOL in all three placements consistently.
User wants a subtle glimpse of an actual AXON / NERVE in the logo. Replace the rigid geometric fork glyph with a reduced organic axon-terminal mark: one slender gently curving horizontal stem comes from left, splits naturally into two short branches toward the right, one branch divides once more, ending in just THREE small tapered or subtly rounded terminal tips. Approximately 5 strokes total, no more. Branching is asymmetrical yet optically balanced. Graceful controlled curves instead of hard 45-degree joins. The whole glyph stays compact and no taller than the wordmark capitals, natural width around 1.1 times its height. Stem thickness should complement the thin-medium letter stems, with a slight taper toward terminal tips. Flat cobalt #2e6fff, one colour, crisp silhouette, clean negative space. The nerve resemblance should appear on a second look, not become a literal biological illustration.
Avoid a big neuron cell body, a brain, dendrite bush, realistic anatomy, roots, tree, antlers, branching coral, too many twigs, dots at every tip, cartoon limbs, glowing effects, gradients, circuit-board symbols or sports-logo angles. Do not add A or X monograms. No extra symbols surrounding the name. The same small organic axon glyph must be repeated faithfully at realistic small scale in both header examples.
Keep everything else unchanged. Preserve enough stroke weight for practical header use. Calm sophisticated identity: a quiet nerve-like branching signal paired with elegant precise typography. One horizontal identity sheet with the main logo large and the two header applications underneath. Change the tiny bottom caption to 'Axon study · a subtle nerve connection'.

selectionStatus: User confirmed: angular cobalt A/junction symbol and bold uppercase wordmark
